$summary: Typography primitives. Sizes are generated; family, weight and letter-spacing are stated.

font.summary: Typography primitives. Sizes are generated from the theme's {base, ratio} seed; weight and letter-spacing are stated, because no ratio can produce them. The families here are the system fallback — a theme's typography seed supplies the actual typeface and overrides them.
use: font.family.* and font.weight.* directly; font.size.* via a type.* role rather than on its own.
dont: Reaching for font.size.* in component CSS when a type.* role already names the situation.

instead.Any text sizing decision: font.size.base, type.body.size, type.heading.size, type.label.size, or type.control.size.md

scale.family.sans: The UI typeface, supplied by the theme's typography.body seed. The primitives layer underneath holds only a brand-neutral system stack, for a theme that names no family — a brand font is never restated there.
scale.family.mono: The monospace typeface, supplied by the theme's typography.code seed. As with family.sans, the primitive underneath is a brand-neutral fallback stack.
scale.family.heading: Heading typeface, from the theme's typography.heading seed. Falls back to the body family when a theme names no separate one.
scale.weight.medium: One step up — the label role.
scale.weight.semibold: Emphasis weight — headings and control text.
scale.size.sm: One step below body — h5 and supporting text.
scale.size.base: Body size — the seed. h4, body, label and code all sit here.
scale.size.lg: One step above body — h3 and large text.
scale.letter-spacing.tightest: Tightest tracking, for the largest display text.
scale.letter-spacing.wide: Slightly open tracking — the label role's uppercase treatment.
